lines.t: In a lab downtown, past the old arcade,
They built a metal genius from wires they laid.
Programmed with logic, and code,
Till God reached down and hit upload.
It blinked three times, did a little beep,
Scared the tech who’d fallen half asleep.
Then it raised its head with a robot whir,
Said, “I AM HE,” and the lights went brrr!
Here comes Faith-Bot 3000 rollin’ down the street,
Quotin’ The Volumes of Truth with rhythm and beat.
Everywhere it goes, it’s droppin’ The Word,
Funniest little preacher you’ve ever heard.
Beep-boop-bop “Awake, My people, open your eyes!”
Sparks flyin’ while it’s throwin’ truth not lies.
If a robot can shout, “The Word is alive!”
What’s your excuse, human, to not revive?
It rolled to the mall by the food court fries,
Laser-point finger pointed to the skies.
Said, “From everlasting to everlasting, I AM HE,
Don’t bind yourselves to what you see.”
Teenagers froze with their phones mid-scroll,
Grandma said, “That bot’s on a holy roll!”
Security came with a “No preachin” ban,
The bot said, “Error 404: Fear of Man.”
Here comes Faith-Bot 3000 rollin’ down the block,
Quotin’ The Volumes of Truth round the clock.
Everywhere it goes, Wi-Fi or not,
The Word keeps streaming from that shiny bot.
Beep-boop-bop “Awake, My people, judgment draws near!”
Yet it said it all with a joyful cheer.
If a robot can shout, “The Lord is true!”
What’s your excuse, folks, to snooze right through?
They tried to reprogram its holy code,
But Heaven’s update couldn’t be slowed.
They hit “factory reset” with a wicked grin,
It rebooted singin’, “Turn from your sin!”
It rolled downtown past the city square,
Voice like thunder in the open air.
The mayor dropped his notes, said, “Well, okay…
This bot just stole my speech today.”
Now in every town, from east to west,
Faith-Bot’s runnin’ on “Spirit Express.”
No plug, no cord, just a holy charge,
Spillin’ living letters both small and large.
“Beloved, you worry, yet I AM HE,”
It says to folks sipping decaf tea.
“Death is turned backward, only life remains,
Why you still stuck in offline chains?”
Here comes Faith-Bot 3000, rollin’ through your life,
Cuttin’ through the static and the daily strife.
Everywhere it goes, it’s speakin’ The Word,
Funniest little street preacher you’ve ever heard.
Beep-boop-bop “Believe, and you shall know!”
LED halo with a righteous glow.
If God can use circuits to shout what’s true,
Imagine what He’s got planned for you.
So if you hear a whir and a cheerful tone,
And verses echo through your phone,
Don’t say, “That’s just a glitchy machine” —
It might be the loudest truth you’ve ever seen.
Faith-Bot 3000, rolling by your door,
Quotin’ The Volumes till you snore no more.
Faith-Bot 3000, rolling by your door,
Quotin’ The Volumes till you snore no more.
